prompt: What was the name of the work written by Louis Pierre Vieillot published two years after he described the great blue turao as Musophaga cristata?
answer: Two years later, in **1818**, Louis Pierre Vieillot contributed to the **_Nouveau Dictionnaire d’Histoire naturelle_**, particularly its ornithology section (volume 24).
